correctness.rationale: The three coordinate-pairing line families are permuted by coordinate automorphisms and preserved by the diagonal subgroup, so the sorted profile is an automorphism invariant. The published orbit representatives have profiles (0,3,3) and (2,2,2), and the two published orbits exhaust all 72 sixers, proving the profile classification. The exact verifier then reconstructs line skewness over Q(omega), all 72 sixers and the 648 automorphisms before exhaustively computing every pair in the 18-orbit. A fresh independent reconstruction over F_7 recovered the same 72 sixers, the 18/54 profile split, three six-element omitted-family blocks, within-block 0:9 and 3:6 intersections, and the global 0:27, 1:108, 3:18 census. The package's Q(omega) computation supplies the characteristic-zero certificate.

final_claim: On the Fermat cubic, the 72 sixers have exactly the profiles (0,3,3) and (2,2,2), which distinguish the 18- and 54-element automorphism orbits; the 18-orbit splits into three omitted-pairing blocks of six, every cross-block pair intersects in one line, each block has nine disjoint and six three-line-intersection pairs, with disjointness graph a triangular prism and three-line-intersection graph C6, giving global pair counts 27,108,18 for intersections 0,1,3.
